lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>{{object}}<c> that automatically applies support effects
to allies. Placed on the <c:ffff00>{{field}}<c>, mostly by <c:ffff00>Set-up skill<c>
<c:ffff00>actions<c>. One type per team; setting another
replaces it.
Its <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> starts at 100. It can't be <c:ffff00>recovered<c>, but
setting the same type again raises it by 50 (max
300); below 100 it returns to 100.
Some types change {{effect}} by {{armor}}.
